description: This file contains the implementation of the SystemTargetBasedMembershipTable class, which manages the membership table for the Orleans runtime using system targets. It includes methods for initializing, reading, updating, and deleting membership entries, as well as internal classes for system target behavior.

classes.name: SystemTargetBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing membership information using system targets.

classes.name: MembershipTableSystemTarget
classes.description: Represents a system target for the membership table, handling in-memory storage and lifecycle participation.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, optionally attempting to initialize table version.

methods.name: GetMembershipTable
methods.description: Retrieves the system target for the membership table, ensuring it's properly initialized.

methods.name: WaitForTableGrainToInit
methods.description: Waits until the membership table grain is initialized, with a timeout depending on debugger attachment.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the membership table for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership row identified by a silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership data from the table.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with a specific table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership row with a new entry and table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the timestamp indicating a node is alive.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes obsolete silo entries from the table.
